analysis:
Reviewed docs/architecture/inference.md. The supplied units (lines 1-805) are mostly unchanged context. The actual PR changes are at lines 1841 and 1864-1871 of the head file, which are outside the supplied text and visible only through the patch excerpt, so the supplied head text cannot be cited for them.

The patch is documentation-only. It records that the catalog Qwen3.5-9B, qwen3.5-35b-a3b and qwen3.6-35b-a3b-vl-mtp-mxfp8 builds (EngineV2SamplingDefaults.qwen35CardModelTypes, bound to model_type) now take model-card sampling defaults when the client omits the knobs: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, presence_penalty 1.5. These are applied because those artifacts ship no generation_config.json.

Security relevance is low.
- Sampling defaults affect output quality and the repetition/max_tokens loop (DoS-adjacent, T-010 and T-029 class). Defaults that stop runaway repetition marginally help availability.
- No change to encryption, the coordinator-to-provider trust boundary, attestation, cache scoping or the SSD prefix cache (T-041), and no change to authorization or billing.
- Residual question for later passes: the actual code change in EngineV2SamplingDefaults is not supplied here. A reviewer should confirm that the defaults apply only when the knobs are omitted and are bound to model_type, so a consumer cannot spoof them. They should also confirm that presence_penalty, in combination with seed or sampling, does not alter cache-scope or prefix-cache reuse semantics. Sampling parameters are not part of the cache key, since the cache keys on token prefixes.

The remaining content (Nemotron Super slot, LOAD claims, prefix bank and logprobs) is unchanged context that was read and creates no new findings. No regression is identified.
